title: Robot reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- chair/body seat -->
  <rect x='34' y='62' width='32' height='26' rx='6' fill='#4FD3C4'/>
  <rect x='38' y='66' width='24' height='18' rx='4' fill='#7FE9DC'/>
  <!-- robot head -->
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='28' height='24' rx='6' fill='#B8C7E0'/>
  <!-- ear bolts -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='36' r='3' fill='#FFB03A'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='36' r='3' fill='#FFB03A'/>
  <!-- face screen -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='20' height='16' rx='4' fill='#14213D'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#7CFFB2'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#7CFFB2'/>
  <!-- little mouth -->
  <path d='M47 40 Q50 42.5 53 40' stroke='#7CFFB2' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='17' stroke='#B8C7E0' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <rect x='30' y='55' width='9' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFB03A'/>
  <rect x='61' y='55' width='9' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFB03A'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M50 52 L34 50 L34 72 L50 70 Z' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M50 52 L66 50 L66 72 L50 70 Z' fill='#FFEFC9'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#E0A84A' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <!-- text lines left -->
  <line x1='38' y1='57' x2='47' y2='56.4' stroke='#B0A48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='61' x2='47' y2='60.4' stroke='#B0A48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='65' x2='47' y2='64.4' stroke='#B0A48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- text lines right -->
  <line x1='53' y1='56.4' x2='62' y2='57' stroke='#C7B48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='60.4' x2='62' y2='61' stroke='#C7B48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='64.4' x2='62' y2='65' stroke='#C7B48E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='11' height='7' rx='3' fill='#B8C7E0'/>
  <rect x='53' y='86' width='11' height='7' rx='3' fill='#B8C7E0'/>
</svg>
